text:
Maria C: Quick heads-up — Nimbus Labs renewal hits next week (5/14). They've asked to reduce 50 seats to 30 and split payment across two POs. I flagged potential proration for the unused seats.
Jordan S: thx. Do we have the current contract term and effective dates handy?
Maria C: Contract started 2025-02-01, annual term. Renewal would be 2026-02-01 if they keep anniversary, but they want a 9-mo adjustment to align with their finance cycle.
Sarah F: 9-mo term is fine but billing will need a credit note for the unused 3 months after the seat reduction. We also need the vendor code from procurement to route payment.
Liam P: From product, feature access is fine for 30 seats. We'll need to update seat allocations in the console and run enablement invite flow again for the reassigned seats.
Maria C: Ok quick checklist: 1) get PO1 (for seats 1-15) and PO2 (for seats 16-30) 2) confirm vendor code 3) confirm 9-mo prorated invoice + credit note 4) get e-sign for amendment.
Jordan S: looping in Nimbus procurement — @nimbus-procurement we need two POs and the vendor code. Also can you confirm whether they want invoices net30 or net45?
Maria C: Customer replied in email: "Prefer Net45, CC billing@nimbus.com".
Sarah F: Net45 ok, but it affects cash flow. We'll set invoice terms Net45 in the amendment and flag on billing. Also need PO numbers embedded on invoice.
Maria C: They sent draft PO numbers: 
```
PO-A: NBL-2026-1456
PO-B: NBL-2026-1457
```
Jordan S: Those look valid. Are they going to e-sign the amendment or do they want a DocuSign link?
Maria C: They asked for DocuSign.
esign-bot: DocuSign package created: Amendment v2 (seats -> 30, term -> 9 months). Link: https://docusign.example.com/r/abc123
Maria C: Sending link to Nimbus now. Also FYI their legal asked for our standard liability clause to remain. No redlines so far.
Liam P: For enablement, can we schedule a 30-min onboarding transfer call for next Tue? I'll prep a short checklist for seat handoff.
Maria C: Yes, propose Tue 10am PST. I'll include the new team leads.
Sarah F: Once both POs are received and DocuSign completed, finance will issue prorated invoice + credit note. Expect ~3 business days to generate.
Jordan S: Noted. Who is owning the PO verification? Maria?
Maria C: I'll verify and upload to Salesforce. Will update this thread when POs and signed amendment are in. :thumbsup:
Maria C: quick update — customer uploaded PO-A but PO-B is pending from their procurement. Waiting on confirmation.
Sarah F: If PO-B delays more than 5 business days we should consider a short-term bridge invoice for seats 1-15 only. Finance can draft.
Maria C: Understood. I'll nudge procurement.
Jordan S: thanks team. cc @Liam P for enablement prep.
Maria C: Final note — ask sales ops to set the renewal risk to "medium" until both POs + esign done.
Maria C: updating SF now.
